names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2076, «Святой Стефан Щилянович», with the rank word left off. The same site's other life page for him spells it «Стефан Шилянович», with ш for щ.

death.note: Two sources, and the narrower reading is taken. His life on days.pravoslavie.ru gives the day: «Святой отошел ко Господу 4 октября 1515 года», and the day line prints «(1515)» after his name. The Serbian Ohrid Prologue, read 4 October 2026, is less certain and names the same year as one report among others: «Упокојио се почетком XVI века (по некима 1515. год.)» — at the beginning of the sixteenth century, by some in 1515. The hedge is recorded here rather than widened into the interval, because the year it hedges about is the year the other source states outright.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «30 августа (Серб.)», which the abbreviation marks as a Serbian commemoration. One row per church is the schema, so the August day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 4 октября ст. ст. — «Св. прав. Стефана Щиляновича (1515) (Серб.).»
source.note: The «(Серб.)» marks this as one of the Serbian commemorations the Russian calendar keeps. The rank is the alt text of the icon the page sets over the group of lines this one stands in, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком».

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 17 octombrie was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: saint.gr/10/17 was not read for him (2026-10-04).

feast.note: Second of the four the Ohrid Prologue enumerates for this day, and the first source this folder has in his own church — it held only the Russian calendar before. Its hedge about his year is recorded in the note on his death rather than taken as a second year.

source.text: Охридски пролог, 4. октобар ст. к. — «2. Св. Стефан Штиљановић. Деспот српски. Родом из Паштровића. Управљао српским народом у претешким приликама борећи се храбро против Турака и Латина. … Упокојио се почетком XVI века (по некима 1515. год.).»
